# Rent a Car with Alamo and Drive Happy®

## Start a Reservation

*Indicates required field [ View/Modify/Cancel ][21]

###### Signing up is fast and free!

## Before you reserve, save with Alamo Insiders!

As an Alamo Insider, you'll **save 5% off** base rates (time and mileage) of pay later reservations.
Terms apply.* Plus, save time at the counter by activating accelerated check -in when you sign up –
simply add more information to your profile!

[ Join ][22]

Already an Alamo Insider?

[Sign In][23]

## Terms And Conditions

*On Pay Later retail rates in the United States, Canada, Mexico, Latin America and the Caribbean.
Discount applies only to the base rate charge (time and mileage) and does not apply to applicable
taxes, fees, surcharges, refueling, drop-off, delivery, youthful driver, additional driver, pick up,
or one way charges or any optional product or service (such as optional damage waiver of $50 or less
per day), which are the responsibility of the Renter.

[Standard of Care]

## Our Standard of Care

We promise to put you first, with exceptional customer service and vehicles that are maintained and
cleaned to our high-quality standards. Everything we do, we do with our Standard of Care.

[ Learn More ][24]

## Already Have a Reservation?

[Find a Reservation]

### Find a Reservation

Need to check details or make a change to your reservation? Look up your Alamo reservation.

[Look Up Reservation][25]

### Activate Accelerated Check-in

Upcoming reservation? Get to the fun fast! Activate Accelerated Check-in to save time at the rental
counter.

[Start Accelerated Check-in][26]

solutions to the global travel industry, fusing human ingenuity with technological innovation.

Unique market leading proprietary tech platform that’s highly scalable with rapid deployment
capabilities.

[ ]

### Global Car Rental & Mobility Supply

Comprehensive breadth of supply to meet all customer segments across car rental, private transfer &
ride-hailing

[ ]

### Best-In-Class Online Retailing

Best-in-class cross-selling technology personalizes display and content to each customer segment.

[ ]

### Continuous Optimisation: Trading Squads

Cross-functional trading squads working with partners to proactively drive performance.

[ ]

### Revenue Management & Personalisation

Enabled by real-time, machine-learning pricing & sort models, and an in-house data science team.

and beyond. Find out more about what we can do for you.

# Alquila un vehículo con Alamo y disfruta de nuestro concepto Drive Happy®

## Iniciar una reserva

*Indica que el campo es obligatorio [ Ver/modificar/cancelar ][18]

## ¿Ya has reservado?

### Buscar una reserva

¿Necesitas comprobar la información o realizar un cambio en tu reserva? Busca tu reserva de Alamo.

[Buscar reserva][19]

### Activar el registro agilizado

Pasa rápidamente a la diversión. Activa el registro agilizado para ahorrar tiempo en el mostrador de
alquiler.

[Empezar registro agilizado][20]

## Alquiler de coches a gran precio en toda España y en todo el mundo

Alamo hace que el [alquiler de coches][21] sea sencillo y asequible. Tanto si necesita un coche
compacto, un SUV o un monovolumen de 7 plazas o minibús de 9 plazas para viajar en familia, nuestra
moderna flota le ofrece todo lo que necesita.

Nuestros precios son claros y razonables, lo que le brinda tranquilidad desde el principio. [Reserve
en línea][22] hoy mismo y aproveche nuestras [últimas ofertas][23] en alquiler de coches baratos.

### Vehículos para cada ocasión

Desde coches urbanos hasta [espaciosos SUVs][24] y [monovolúmenes][25], Alamo ofrece coches modernos
y aptos para toda la familia que se adaptan a cada viaje. Elija el coche adecuado para su viaje y
conduzca con confianza.

### Precios transparentes

Ofrecemos tarifas competitivas con todo incluido sin cargos ocultos para que sepa exactamente lo que
está pagando.

[Nuestras mejores ofertas de alquiler de coches]

  reducir los niveles de exceso estándar.

### Popular Questions About Renting a Car in Europe

#### Can an American rent a car in Europe?

Of course! In most European countries, all Americans need is a valid US driver's license and
passport to rent a car in Europe. Be aware there are popular travel destinations that require
driver's from the United States to acquire an [International Driving Permit][49]; Italy is one of
these countries! IDP's are fairly cheap and can be acquired online before your trip or at a local
AAA branch. Contact Auto Europe for more information on your European car rental.

#### How old do you have to be to rent a car in Europe?

To rent a car in Europe, drivers must be at least 21 years old (age may vary by car category). Some
car rental suppliers will have rental options for drivers over the age of 18 and looking to rent a
car in Europe. Additionally, any driver hoping to [rent a car under the age of 25][50] may incur a
young driver surcharge in addition to the daily rate.

#### Do I need extra insurance when renting a car in Europe?

All Auto Europe Car Rentals include liability and fire insurance at no extra cost. Liability insures
against any damage done to anything outside of the rental car, while fire insurance protects against
mechanical fires. More comprehensive coverage typically includes a Collision Damage Waiver (CDW)
insuring damage done to the rental car in the event of an accident and Theft Protection to cover the
loss if the rental vehicle is stolen while you are in Europe. When [renting a car in Italy][51], it
is required renters purchase CDW and Theft Protection in their insurance plan. Check with your
reservation agent what is required at your destination.

Find more information from Auto Europe on [car rental insurance in Europe][52].

#### How much is a rental car per day in Europe?

Similar to airline tickets, the cost per day to rent a car varies greatly based on your destination,
the time of year, and the car class you choose to rent. Economy and smaller-sized rentals can be as
little as $15-$20 a day in popular cities in France and Italy. Luxury vehicles & SUVs will have
higher daily rates but keep an eye out for specials or promotions; in some countries, Auto Europe
provides free car class upgrades on rentals throughout the year.

Find more [questions and answers about renting a car in Europe][53] with Auto Europe today!

### Popular Questions About Renting a Car in Europe

#### Can an American rent a car in Europe?

Of course! In most European countries, all Americans need is a valid US driver's license and
passport to rent a car in Europe. Be aware there are popular travel destinations that require
driver's from the United States to acquire an [International Driving Permit][49]; Italy is one of
these countries! IDP's are fairly cheap and can be acquired online before your trip or at a local
AAA branch. Contact Auto Europe for more information on your European car rental.

#### How old do you have to be to rent a car in Europe?

To rent a car in Europe, drivers must be at least 21 years old (age may vary by car category). Some
car rental suppliers will have rental options for drivers over the age of 18 and looking to rent a
car in Europe. Additionally, any driver hoping to [rent a car under the age of 25][50] may incur a
young driver surcharge in addition to the daily rate.

#### Do I need extra insurance when renting a car in Europe?

All Auto Europe Car Rentals include liability and fire insurance at no extra cost. Liability insures
against any damage done to anything outside of the rental car, while fire insurance protects against
mechanical fires. More comprehensive coverage typically includes a Collision Damage Waiver (CDW)
insuring damage done to the rental car in the event of an accident and Theft Protection to cover the
loss if the rental vehicle is stolen while you are in Europe. When [renting a car in Italy][51], it
is required renters purchase CDW and Theft Protection in their insurance plan. Check with your
reservation agent what is required at your destination.

Find more information from Auto Europe on [car rental insurance in Europe][52].

#### How much is a rental car per day in Europe?

Similar to airline tickets, the cost per day to rent a car varies greatly based on your destination,
the time of year, and the car class you choose to rent. Economy and smaller-sized rentals can be as
little as $15-$20 a day in popular cities in France and Italy. Luxury vehicles & SUVs will have
higher daily rates but keep an eye out for specials or promotions; in some countries, Auto Europe
provides free car class upgrades on rentals throughout the year.

Find more [questions and answers about renting a car in Europe][53] with Auto Europe today!

### Timely delivery, prompt response, stress-free process. - Says Rana Chatterjee

My sudden decision to buy my dream car Audi Q3 just a few days before Dhanteras was a surprise for
my family and even for myself. I was skeptical about the timely delivery because of the obvious
reason of high demand during Diwali & Dhanteras. I approached Ayvens and the way Hatesh & his team
handled the process was fabulous. The entire execution from booking to paperwork to delivery was a
stress -free journey for me. They ensured that I got the car on my desired day. I was kept updated
throughout the process including registration & Insurance. The team was very responsive and answered
all my queries promptly. Highly recommend their services.

### Timely delivery, prompt response, stress-free process. - Says Rana Chatterjee

My sudden decision to buy my dream car Audi Q3 just a few days before Dhanteras was a surprise for
my family and even for myself. I was skeptical about the timely delivery because of the obvious
reason of high demand during Diwali & Dhanteras. I approached Ayvens and the way Hatesh & his team
handled the process was fabulous. The entire execution from booking to paperwork to delivery was a
stress -free journey for me. They ensured that I got the car on my desired day. I was kept updated
throughout the process including registration & Insurance. The team was very responsive and answered
all my queries promptly. Highly recommend their services.

CARWIZ

AVIS CAR RENTAL

DiscoverCars.com is a leader in online car rental bookings; we compare car rental deals from many

# Discover Drivalia Car Hire

**The New Planet Mobility**: Drivalia UK Ltd is part of the Credit Agricole Auto Bank Group and with
over 40 prime car rental locations including all major airports such as [Heathrow][45],
[Gatwick][46], [Manchester][47] and [Edinburgh][48] plus city locations, Drivalia offers a
high-quality, low cost car rental experience with friendly service.

Drivalia wants to represent the “Planet of Mobility” of the future, providing its customers with the
widest range of mobility solutions: from electric car sharing to innovative car subscriptions,
passing through short, medium, and long-term rental.

Drivalias’ modern fleet of rental vehicles caters to all requirements. Economical, urban cars are
ideal for short stay city breaks whilst the SUV range is perfect for families ready to explore
further afield.

Need something a little bigger? Spacious people carriers cater to larger groups and for business
users, the executive car range features some of the best and most prestigious models available. Book
direct with Drivalia for your next car rental.

#### **Key Locations**

Drivalia has over 30 convenient car rental branches throughout the UK, including major airports and
downtown areas.
[View Locations][49]

#### **Business Car Rental**

Explore our business page for premium fleet solutions and customised programmes designed to meet
your organisation’s needs.
[Business Car Rental][50]

#### **Van Rental**

From house clearances, light haulage and moving home, Drivalia has a rental van for every need at
great prices.
[Van Rental][51]

## All-inclusive car rental with Drivalia

Drivalia prides itself on offering the value for money. We have become one of the highest-rated
suppliers thanks to our fair and transparent prices, impressive cars, and high-quality service.

The company is present in 7 European countries (Italy, France, United Kingdom, Spain, Portugal,
Greece and Denmark), with over 650 Drivalia Mobility Stores, 1,600 charging points throughout the
country, and extensive fleet of green vehicles.

“Planet Mobility” is the claim we have chosen to represent ourselves because it reflects our
vocation for 360 ° mobility and customer service.

# Discover Drivalia Car Hire

**The New Planet Mobility**: Drivalia UK Ltd is part of the Credit Agricole Auto Bank Group and with
over 40 prime car rental locations including all major airports such as [Heathrow][45],
[Gatwick][46], [Manchester][47] and [Edinburgh][48] plus city locations, Drivalia offers a
high-quality, low cost car rental experience with friendly service.

Drivalia wants to represent the “Planet of Mobility” of the future, providing its customers with the
widest range of mobility solutions: from electric car sharing to innovative car subscriptions,
passing through short, medium, and long-term rental.

Drivalias’ modern fleet of rental vehicles caters to all requirements. Economical, urban cars are
ideal for short stay city breaks whilst the SUV range is perfect for families ready to explore
further afield.

Need something a little bigger? Spacious people carriers cater to larger groups and for business
users, the executive car range features some of the best and most prestigious models available. Book
direct with Drivalia for your next car rental.

#### **Key Locations**

Drivalia has over 30 convenient car rental branches throughout the UK, including major airports and
downtown areas.
[View Locations][49]

#### **Business Car Rental**

Explore our business page for premium fleet solutions and customised programmes designed to meet
your organisation’s needs.
[Business Car Rental][50]

#### **Van Rental**

From house clearances, light haulage and moving home, Drivalia has a rental van for every need at
great prices.
[Van Rental][51]

## All-inclusive car rental with Drivalia

Drivalia prides itself on offering the value for money. We have become one of the highest-rated
suppliers thanks to our fair and transparent prices, impressive cars, and high-quality service.

The company is present in 7 European countries (Italy, France, United Kingdom, Spain, Portugal,
Greece and Denmark), with over 650 Drivalia Mobility Stores, 1,600 charging points throughout the
country, and extensive fleet of green vehicles.

“Planet Mobility” is the claim we have chosen to represent ourselves because it reflects our
vocation for 360 ° mobility and customer service.

# Great things happen with the right fleet solutions

EFS and Fleet One solutions by WEX Fleet help owner-operators and major carriers alike run smarter
and more efficiently. Find the fleet solutions you need to stay ahead.

[Get Started][36]
[two men in front of truck]

## Fleet One Solutions

### Competitive discounts for growing fleets

Every dollar you save gives your growing fleet the edge it needs. The Fleet One EDGE Card helps you
save thousands per year in fuel discounts alone, and gives you big discounts on tires, maintenance,
wireless plans, and more.

[Fleet One EDGE Card][37]
[woman in front of fleet of trucks]

## EFS Fleet Solutions

### World-class tools for mid to large enterprise fleets

EFS helps freight carriers unlock the value behind payments, so you can focus on making your
business the best it can be. EFS fuel cards set the standard for security and control, with add-on
solutions to improve efficiency and performance based on your exact needs.

[EFS Fleet Card][38]
[EFS Fleet Mastercard][39]
[Fleet Digital Payments][40]
[man on computer]

## WEX Capital

### Everything truckers need to keep cash flowing

Our approach is simple. Easy factoring to get you paid today, cash flow to keep you moving tomorrow,
and fuel discounts to keep you saving mile after mile. No hidden fees, no surprises. With 30+ years
in trucking finance, we’re the cash flow partner you’ve been looking for.

[WEX Capital][41]

depósito en cualquier sucursal bancaria autorizada.

### Membership and Benefits
*  **Why Should I Become a Garenta Member?**

To rent a car from any of our locations throughout Türkiye, it’s essential that you create a
membership by providing your ID and driver’s license details. Being a member opens up a world of
opportunities for you to enjoy various advantages through our brand partnerships, along with
exclusive offers tailored specifically for Garentans.
* **How Old Do I Need to be to Rent a Car?**

You must be at least 21 years old and have a class B driver’s license for at least 1 year to rent a
car. If you are 20 years old and have held a valid driver’s license for at least 1 year, you can
rent a car by purchasing the young driver package.
* **How Can I Stay Up-to-Date About Offers?**

You can secure your booking by exploring the competitive prices available in the “Offers by Garenta”
section on our “Campaigns” page. You can also stay updated on our offers by enabling communication
permissions, allowing us to send you SMS and mobile app notifications for prompt announcements.
* **How Can I Use Partnership Offers?**

You can access exclusive discounts tailored for users and employees of our partner brands by
visiting our “Campaigns” page. Once you’ve obtained a discount code from the relevant page, you can
book at favorable rates by specifying your desired car.
* **What Are “Garenta-Exclusive” Offers?**

You can discover the advantages available to Garenta members when shopping with various brands in
the dedicated “Garentan-Exclusive” section on our “Campaigns” page. You can take full advantage of
the respective brand’s offerings by reviewing the usage details. To receive a discount code from us,
please ensure that you have enabled SMS and mobile application push notification permissions.

### Renting Process

**How Can I Book a Car?**
To rent the ideal car from Garenta’s diverse fleet that best suits your needs, you can make a
reservation directly without requiring membership. However, completing the membership process
through the Garenta website or mobile app, visiting one of our offices across Türkiye, or contacting
our Booking Center will provide a faster and more seamless rental experience. 

**What is the Minimum Duration for a Rental Period?**
The minimum rental period is 24 hours. For rentals that are less than one day (24 hours), a daily
rental fee applies.

**Will I Receive the Same Make and Model Car I Booked? **
The car images displayed on our website and mobile application serve as representative examples of
the respective car classes. We cannot guarantee the availability of the specific make, model, or
color of the car requested in the booking. Based on the real-time availability of cars at the time
of delivery, it’s possible that a different car from the same class with similar features may be
provided.

**Are There Alternative Payment Methods Besides Credit Cards? **
We exclusively accept Visa and Mastercard credit cards as payment methods, and virtual cards and
debit cards are not accepted. 

**I Don’t Use a Credit Card / My Card Doesn’t Have Sufficient Limit: Can I Split the Payment Across
Multiple Cards or Use Someone Else’s Credit Card for Payment?**
The vehicle rental fee, along with any additional product and service charges and the security
deposit, is collected in advance from the renter's own credit card(s) at the beginning of the rental
period. Payments can be made using multiple credit cards belonging to the same person; however,
third-party credit cards cannot be used. Any additional charges or refunds during the rental period
will also be processed through the same card(s).
**Can I Pay Later?**
During the booking process, you have the option to select “Pay Later” as your payment method,
allowing you to complete the payment at our offices when you pick up your car. If preferred, you can
secure your booking at discounted rates by utilizing our “Pay Now” option.

**What are the Terms & Conditions for Cancellation/Refund?**

In prepaid reservations, if the reservation is canceled at least 1 hour before the vehicle pickup
time, the full rental fee will be refunded. If the cancellation is made less than 1 hour before the
rental start time, a penalty fee of 30% of the total amount will be charged.

**If I Return The Car Earlier Than Planned, Will I Get a Refund for The Unused Days?**

In case of early return, a penalty fee of 15% of the unused rental days will be charged, and the
remaining amount will be refunded.

**When Will I Receive My Invoice?**
Your invoice will be sent to the email address you provided at the beginning of the rental within 7
business days after your rental ends.

**Can I Be Sure That I Will Rent The Exact Car I Reserved?**
Reservations are made based on vehicle groups, and a specific model is not guaranteed. If a car from
your reserved group is unavailable at the specified time, a higher-segment car will be provided at
the same price.

**Can I Add an Additional Driver After Renting The Car?**
An additional driver can be added to the rental agreement. However, if you are the main driver, you
must visit the office with both the car and the additional driver. A damage inspection will be
conducted at the office, and both the main and additional drivers will need to sign the rental
agreement again.

**What Do I Need When Picking Up The Car?**
You need to present your driver’s license, an identity card with your Turkish ID number (or a
passport if you are coming from abroad), and a credit card in your name. Customers with foreign
driver’s licenses must ensure that the entry stamp in their passport is not older than 6 months.

**Can I Rent More Than One Car At The Same Time?**

You can only rent one car at a time. However, you can make a separate reservation for a different
date while another rental is ongoing.

**Do Your Rental Cars Have A Mileage Limit?**

For daily rentals, there is a 500 km usage limit per day. If the daily limit exceeds the monthly
limit, the total mileage used cannot exceed the monthly limit for that vehicle group, regardless of
the number of rental days. Additional mileage packages can be purchased from the "Extra Services"
section. Any excess mileage at the time of return will be charged based on the current mileage
overage rates. For monthly rentals, the mileage limit varies between 3,000 and 4,000 km depending on
the vehicle group. You can find detailed information on our website or by contacting our Reservation
Center.
**What Should I Do If I Experience An Issue with The Website or Mobile App?**
You can contact us by filling out the communication form via [Garenta Contact][32].

**What is Additional Insurance Coverage? How Can I Purchase it?**
**[Click ][33]**[**here**][34] for detailed information on additional coverage.

**Can I Return The Car To A Different Office?**
Yes, for an additional one-way fee, you can return the car to a different office. If the vehicle is
picked up in one city and returned in another, the pre-determined one-way fee set by Garenta will
apply. One-way fees vary by location and can be viewed during the reservation process. For more
details, you can contact our Reservation Center.

## Why us?
* No fine print
  We never hide our prices, terms and conditions. No hidden fees or taxes. You can see the exact
  price that will not change in the booking process.
* Low deposits
  In international rental companies deposits may reach up to several thousand euros, which will be
  blocked on the client’s bank account. Our average deposit is 300 euros, and we have plenty of car
  rental companies that do not require deposits at all.
* Fair damage assessment
  We assess damage in the presence of a client. Our prices are 2-3 times lower than in international
  car rental companies. And we never charge our clients after they have returned the car.

## Why us?
* No fine print
  We never hide our prices, terms and conditions. No hidden fees or taxes. You can see the exact
  price that will not change in the booking process.
* Low deposits
  In international rental companies deposits may reach up to several thousand euros, which will be
  blocked on the client’s bank account. Our average deposit is 300 euros, and we have plenty of car
  rental companies that do not require deposits at all.
* Fair damage assessment
  We assess damage in the presence of a client. Our prices are 2-3 times lower than in international
  car rental companies. And we never charge our clients after they have returned the car.

  hundreds of searches at once.
  
  momondo is completely free to use - with no hidden charges or fees - and the prices you see are
  never affected by your searches, no matter how many you make.

  is available to us all, so we’re committed to showing you the cheapest flights in our flight
  finder.
* How do I find the best price on plane tickets?
  Choose your destination and preferred travel dates, and we’ll provide you with an overview of the

  most popular flight routes.

  Sometimes you can save money by combining flight tickets from different suppliers, and we call
  that Mix & Match. This means you can book your outbound flight with one supplier, and your return

  a traditional round-trip with one supplier. It’s an advanced way of getting the cheapest flights
  even if they’re offered by different suppliers.

Car Rental Services at Phuket Airport
Car Rental Services at Phuket Airport For passengers arriving at Phuket Airport who wish to travel
into the city or continue their journey while maintaining privacy, speed, and safety, the airport
offers various car rental services. These services are available on the first floor of the airport.
Here are the car rental companies available at Phuket Airport: Passengers can book car rentals in
advance at special prices and claim privileges from various car rental brands through the Sawasdee
by AOT Application, available on both *When traveling to airports, passengers should allow at least
2 hours in advance to ensure timely boarding, as there are quite a few procedures involved.
Alternatively, booking a hotel near the airport for a night’s stay can also be a convenient
option.
[READ MORE ][22]
How to get to Phuket Airport
How to get to Phuket Airport Car / Airport Shuttle For passengers who want to travel to Phuket
Airport or tourists who board a flight back to Bangkok, they can easily book the airport shuttle
service in advance for convenience and speed. Tourists who use the rental car service can return the
car at the front car rental counter at Phuket Airport. Airport Bus For those who don't like to
drive. Airport buses are a very good option. There are stops covering people throughout the city,
and there are buses leaving every hour. The schedule is clear, suitable for people who have time to
spare and do not have a lot of luggage, and it is available in front of the exit of the arrival hall
and the station until the 1st passenger drop-off. Details are as follows: Phuket Airport –
City 8.15 – 20.15 hrs. City – Phuket Airport 9.15 – 21.15 hrs. Bus Route : Same
route to and from the airport – Indigo Pearl Hotel – Wat Phra Nang Sang – Thao
Thep Monument – Boat Lagoon – Premium Outlet – Irrawaddy Bypass – Tesco
Lotus Intersection Big C – Central – Surakul Stadium – Panthep Condo Town –
Merlin Hotel Intersection – Phuket Women's School Intersection – Old Bus Station (City)
Airport Bus Express The service is available in front of the exit of the arrival hall and the
station until the 1st passenger drop-off is also available, with the following details: Airport
– Patong Beach 08.00 – 20.00 hrs. Patong Beach - Airport 06.00 – 18.30 hrs. Bus
route : The same route to and from the airport – Fort Muang Mai – Thalang – Lotus
Thalang – Tha Pier – Boat Lagoon – Lotus Sabai Pass – Kathu Intersection
– Patong Beach Phuket Smart Bus Pleases tourists who want to travel to the beaches. In Phuket,
the Smart Bus service can be used at the Domestic Terminal, which is close to the arrival exit,
suitable for tourists who book beach accommodations or backpackers who want to experience Phuket's
famous beaches. Bus route : Phuket Airport – Sukthalang Public Office – Ban Kian -Boat
Avenue Choeng Talay - Tesco Lotus Cherng Talay – Surin Beach – Kamala Beach –
Phuket Fanta Sea – Big C Kamala – Patong Beach – Karon Beach – Kata Beach
– Saiyuan – Rawai Beach *Allow time for travel as the queue will only be available for
hours as scheduled. Public Passenger Vans For people who travel alone or want to enter the city
without having to stop a lot, a van is the most suitable because it can be flexible. Do not leave
the car around and only stop at important beaches, namely Phuket Airport – Patong Beach
– Kata Beach – Karon Beach.

## Frequently asked questions about car rental

[See all questions][9]

### What are the minimum requirements for renting a car?

There are a few different requirements for car rental that depend on the location where you rent. In
the United States or Canada, you must be at least 25 years old, have a valid driver's license for at
least 2 years, and a credit card under your name (selected rental companies also accept debit
cards). If you are traveling to another country, an International Driving Permit (IDP) is required
in some cases.

### How does a car rental security deposit work?

The car rental security deposit, or pre-authorization, is a sum of money held against your credit
card limit for the rental company’s own safety. This isn’t charged as a normal purchase, but only
put on hold for the duration of your reservation. This is done when you pick-up the rental car, and
the full amount is released after drop-off.

### What is included in the car rental rate?

The rental rate at Rentcars typically includes unlimited mileage, basic mandatory protections, and
rental agency administrative fees. Optional items such as child seats or GPS may be available at the
rental counter. Always review your rental agreement carefully to ensure it meets your needs, as some
agencies might have mileage restrictions or optional protections.

### How do the car rental protections work?

Car rental protections cover damage to the vehicle, personal accidents, and liability. Common
protections include LDW (Loss Damage Waiver), CDW (Collision Damage Waiver), ALI (Additional
Liability Insurance), and PAI (Personal Accident Insurance). Coverage names and specifics can vary
by rental company. In case of an incident, file a police report and follow the rental company’s
procedures. Additional protections can be purchased online or at the rental counter.

### What is and how to use a discount code?

Discount codes are promotional offers that reduce your rental rate when applied at checkout. To use
them, enter the code on the payment page during reservation. The fare will update automatically if
the code is valid. Discount codes can be obtained through exclusive promotions, newsletters, or
referral programs. Note that they cannot be combined with cashback offers and cannot be reused if a
reservation is canceled.

### What is a One-Way car rental fee?

The One-Way car rental fee, also known as the Drop-Off Fee, is charged when a vehicle is returned to
a different location than pick-up. This fee covers the cost of taking the car back to its original
location. To check out prices including a One-Way fee, select the "Drop-off at different location"
option.

### How do I compare car rental prices on Rentcars?

To compare the best car rental prices, all you have to do is select your pick-up location (city or
airport, your choice), as well as the pick-up and drop-off date and time. It is also possible to
rent one-way, just select “Drop-off at different location”. After you hit “Search”, Rentcars will
list the best car rental offers, which you can filter by your favorite rental company, desired car
category, price range and more.

### Is it worth renting with Rentcars?

Absolutely! With Rentcars, compare rates from over 350 car rental companies worldwide in one place,
choose the perfect rental op

For more than 75 years, Sanborn’s Mexico Auto Insurance has been a constant travel partner for those
driving into Mexico. We offer a customizable range of products including Mexican car insurance,
Mexico home insurance, international medical insurance and more.

purchase online or use a kiosk to complete your transaction quickly and easily. You must have Mexico
car insurance to drive in Mexico, so let the experts at Sanborn’s help you stay safe and legal.

# Shuru App – Made for You and Your Cityzens

## Where your voice shapes your city

Join 1 crore+ users across India, building a connected, informed, and active community at your
location.

[ Download Now][1]Explore Services
[phone][phone]

1cr+ users

8000+ sub-districts

## Why Shuru App?

## The Power of Local Connectivity

[phone][phone]
Location-Based Community

Shuru connects you with your local community—wherever you are. Join conversations in 600+ cities and
8000+ districts across India. Share updates, solve problems, and stay engaged with what truly
matters around you.

[phone][phone]
Citizen Empowerment

Post local issues, share updates, and offer solutions. Shuru helps you improve your neighborhood
with support from people who care.

[phone][phone]
Business & Advertising Opportunities

For local businesses, Shuru offers a strong platform to advertise and increase visibility within
your area. Reach out to potential customers, promote your products or services, and grow your
business right where it matters most.

[phone][phone]
Become Popular in your area

If you're a local influencer — whether a politician, social worker, teacher, doctor, or youth leader
— Shuru gives you powerful tools to share your voice, build trust, and grow your influence across
your city.

[phone][phone]
Share and get updates of your city

Shuru is your go-to platform to stay informed and connected with your neighborhood. Whether you’re
sharing a road closure, promoting a shop offer, raising awareness about a civic concern etc, Shuru
empowers you to be an active voice in your community.

### Экономия

Такси из аэропорта ~30–50€, по городу 40–70€ в день. Аренда — от 15€/сутки.

### Комфорт семье

Без ожиданий такси на жаре, больше места и удобнее с детьми.

### Престиж бизнесу

Премиальное авто, кондиционер, Wi-Fi — встречи по графику.

## Мы решаем ваши задачи

### Для семей с детьми

**Проблемы:** ограниченность экскурсий, недовольство детей, нехватка места.

**Ваши выгоды:** минивэны, бесплатные кресла, спонтанные остановки, комфорт в путешествии.

### Для бизнес-туристов

**Проблемы:** потеря времени, языковой барьер, отсутствие статусного автомобиля.

**Ваши выгоды:** Mercedes/BMW/Audi, встреча в аэропорту, Wi-Fi, конфиденциальность, поездки по
вашему графику.

### Для планирующих путешествие

**Проблемы:** риск не найти подходящий транспорт, скрытые платежи, сложности с оформлением.

**Ваши выгоды:** гарантия бронирования, фиксированные условия, поддержка на русском, полные детали
бронирования.

### Для спонтанных решений

**Проблемы:** срочная потребность, долгое оформление.

**Ваши выгоды:** автомобиль в день обращения, доставка за 1–2 часа, минимум документов.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Collision Damage Waiver (CDW)?

Collision Damage Waiver (CDW) reduces your liability in the event of an accident during your car
rental. Without this, you could be liable for the full cost of the rental car if it were to be
damaged or written off. CDW means you won’t have to pay the full cost of any repairs as long as
you’ve followed the T&C’s.

CDW is always included when booking with Zest Car Rental with either No Excess or Excess
Reimbursement. CDW is sometimes known as Loss Damage Waiver or Damage Excess Waiver.

### Do I need a credit card to rent a car?

You need to be in possession of a valid credit card to collect a rental car. This MUST be in the
name of the main driver and CANNOT be a pre-paid credit card or a debit card and must have
sufficient funds available.

This enables the car rental provider to authorise a security deposit, which covers any parking or
speeding fines, uninsured parts of the vehicle, fuel charges if applicable, and in the unlikely
event that a claim is made when the insurance has been invalidated.

### What happens if I damage a rental car?

If you are involved in an accident you must obtain a police report and contact the car rental
provider to advise them of the accident immediately.

You will need to fill out a damage report for insurance purposes. Depending on how the accident
occurred, for example due to negligence, you may be liable for the costs involved; however, this is
assessed on a case by case basis by the car rental provider.

### How old can I be to rent a car?

In some locations we operate with car rental providers that will allow someone under the age of 25
to hire a vehicle without any additional cost.

Many car rental providers have a minimum age limit of 23 or 25 years. When entering the dates and
times of your hire, simply enter your age in the 'Drivers Age' box.

We will show all options available to you, sometimes a driver age surcharge may be applicable.

### Am I too old to rent a car?

In most locations worldwide, we operate with car rental providers that will allow someone over the
age of 70 to hire a vehicle without any additional cost.

When entering the dates and times of your hire, simply enter your age in the 'Drivers Age' box.

We will show all options available to you, sometimes a driver age surcharge may be applicable.

### Do I need a DVLA code to rent a car in the UK?

If you have a UK driving licence and are renting a car in the UK or Ireland, you must obtain a DVLA
code to share your driving licence details.

To obtain this from the DVLA website, you will need your driving licence number, National Insurance
number and the postcode on your driving licence. The code is valid for 21 days.

When collecting a car in the UK or Ireland, car rental providers usually require your passport and
additional proof of address. Please check the information icon (i) displayed next to the heading
Licence Requirements during the booking process or the pre-paid car hire voucher for more
information before collecting your hire car.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Collision Damage Waiver (CDW)?

Collision Damage Waiver (CDW) reduces your liability in the event of an accident during your car
rental. Without this, you could be liable for the full cost of the rental car if it were to be
damaged or written off. CDW means you won’t have to pay the full cost of any repairs as long as
you’ve followed the T&C’s.

CDW is always included when booking with Zest Car Rental with either No Excess or Excess
Reimbursement. CDW is sometimes known as Loss Damage Waiver or Damage Excess Waiver.

### Do I need a credit card to rent a car?

You need to be in possession of a valid credit card to collect a rental car. This MUST be in the
name of the main driver and CANNOT be a pre-paid credit card or a debit card and must have
sufficient funds available.

This enables the car rental provider to authorise a security deposit, which covers any parking or
speeding fines, uninsured parts of the vehicle, fuel charges if applicable, and in the unlikely
event that a claim is made when the insurance has been invalidated.

### What happens if I damage a rental car?

If you are involved in an accident you must obtain a police report and contact the car rental
provider to advise them of the accident immediately.

You will need to fill out a damage report for insurance purposes. Depending on how the accident
occurred, for example due to negligence, you may be liable for the costs involved; however, this is
assessed on a case by case basis by the car rental provider.

### How old can I be to rent a car?

In some locations we operate with car rental providers that will allow someone under the age of 25
to hire a vehicle without any additional cost.

Many car rental providers have a minimum age limit of 23 or 25 years. When entering the dates and
times of your hire, simply enter your age in the 'Drivers Age' box.

We will show all options available to you, sometimes a driver age surcharge may be applicable.

### Am I too old to rent a car?

In most locations worldwide, we operate with car rental providers that will allow someone over the
age of 70 to hire a vehicle without any additional cost.

When entering the dates and times of your hire, simply enter your age in the 'Drivers Age' box.

We will show all options available to you, sometimes a driver age surcharge may be applicable.

### Do I need a DVLA code to rent a car in the UK?

If you have a UK driving licence and are renting a car in the UK or Ireland, you must obtain a DVLA
code to share your driving licence details.

To obtain this from the DVLA website, you will need your driving licence number, National Insurance
number and the postcode on your driving licence. The code is valid for 21 days.

When collecting a car in the UK or Ireland, car rental providers usually require your passport and
additional proof of address. Please check the information icon (i) displayed next to the heading
Licence Requirements during the booking process or the pre-paid car hire voucher for more
information before collecting your hire car.
